details: Employed various classification models and utilized different metrics, achieving overall model accuracy of 88%.

Developed a generic function for data preprocessing and wrangling, including data profiling, cleaning, and outlier treatment, streamlining the data preparation process and reducing preparation time by 40%.
Built a multipurpose Triage AI agent for a stock brokerage firm using MCP, enabling Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) on text and images, and natural language text-to-SQL queries.
Developed an Agentic HR Workflow with LangGraph, building a scalable HR automation pipeline to handle queries on hiring, holidays, and leave policies, easily integrable with existing systems.
